prerequisites: The Swedish entry level test. Based on the score, the student will either complete a Swedish course at the Language Centre that corresponds to their proficiency level, including examinations, or demonstrate advanced familiarity with Swedish language (e.g., language immersion background, Swedish as a second home language, military service completed in Swedish) and previously acquired good basic language skills in their own field of study in a separate general examination. A student wishing to complete the Swedish examinations as general examinations without course participation must obtain a minimum score of 35 in the entry level test and write a motivation letter of at least 300 words in Swedish in a video-proctored EXAM exam room without aids.

learning_outcomes.text: The goal is for students taking the test to demonstrate such satisfactory written proficiency in Swedish as the Aalto University Schools' degree regulations require, and as is required by law (Act 424/2003 and decree 481/2003) of State personnel in bilingual authorities and as is necessary for their field.

syllabus_topics: Written test consisting of two texts related to communication at work and/or to the field of study.
